cases.case: A: event exactly at windowSecs boundary (t=300s, window=300s)
cases.observed: alerts=1 (rangeBetween(-300,0) is CLOSED => included, so 3>=3 should alert)

cases.case: B: event 1s beyond windowSecs boundary (t=301s, window=300s)
cases.observed: alerts=0 (only e1 at t=0 falls out of range; e2/e3 still within 300s of e4, so count=2 < 3 expected)

cases.case: C: 3 failures within the same second (sub-second timestamps), then success
cases.observed: alerts=1 (parseTs(...).cast("long") truncates to whole seconds — sub-second ordering is not preserved)

cases.case: D: 2 fully separate qualifying incidents, same account, 1 day apart (SequenceThenTrigger)
cases.observed: alertRows=2 (expected 2 — one alert row per qualifying TRIGGER event, no cross-incident dedup)

cases.case: E: 2 fully separate qualifying incidents, same host, 1 day apart (DistinctCountWithinWindow)
cases.observed: alertRows=2 [(windowStart=2025-12-31T23:55:02.000Z, detectedAt=2026-01-01T00:00:02.000Z), (windowStart=2026-01-01T23:55:02.000Z, detectedAt=2026-01-02T00:00:02.000Z)] (FIXED, Phase D: one alert per incident — a rising edge in the rolling distinct count, not one collapsed row per groupKey ever — so 2 fully separate incidents now correctly produce 2 alert rows, each with its own detectedAt and a windowStart exactly windowSecs before it, the same per-trigger-event granularity SequenceThenTrigger already had)

cases.case: F: one event has an unparseable timestamp (SequenceThenTrigger)
G: mfa_required=true in policy, but mfa_used is NULL on the event itself (not missing, null)
cases.observed: status=insufficient_context (FIXED, Phase D: policy lookup succeeded, but the logField itself is null on this event — checked explicitly now, for both comparisonOps, before the three-valued-logic comparison ever runs, so an unobserved value correctly degrades to insufficient_context instead of being silently read as compliant)

cases.case: H: 2 separate qualifying login_success events, same account, no mfa (PolicyCompare)
cases.observed: alertRows=2 (expected 2 — PolicyCompare alerts once per qualifying EVENT, no dedup at all)

cases.case: I: expected_auth_method=password in policy, but auth_method is NULL on the event (notEqual op)
cases.observed: status=insufficient_context (FIXED, Phase D: the same three-valued-logic gap as case G existed in 'notEqual' too — `col(logField) =!= col(policyField)` is also NULL when logField is NULL, previously falling through to no_alert here as well; both comparisonOps now check logField.isNull explicitly before comparing)
